This smartphone UI screen displays the "Application Terms of Use" for a mobile or tablet application. The main contents and functions of this screen include:

1. **Title Bar**: 
   - The title "TERMS OF USE" is displayed at the top.
   - There are options to adjust text size (Aa) and share the document (share icon).

2. **Main Content**:
   - The main body of the screen contains the "APPLICATION TERMS OF USE" text.
   - It outlines the legal agreement between the user and NBCUniversal Media, LLC, specifying that Apple is not responsible for the content of the application.
   - Users are advised to read the license before downloading or using the application and to review the Usage Rules of the iPhone App Store Terms and Conditions.
